source_scope: Mounting Stage2; local lead SPACE budget, not full wiring or stock
cause_change: First candidate Y42 is too far for50mm local links. Supplier photo also does not support assuming7.62mm total row separation. Allocate board height, support/hardware, wider pad rows and local lead allowance together before CAD

local_space_screen.rule: Use wider photo-consistent pad row assumption for screen. Never call lower bound a cut length or proof of routing. Actual bends/insulation/solder ends and pin mapping remain separate qualification; do not silently relax50mm

assembly: Retain known carrier/PCB/clamp/side-rail sequence and lateral rear nut access
Fit actual bare adapter hole coordinates in CAD and verify both faces/pads before printing local attachment; no drilling the supplied PCB or edge-clamping pad rows
Two spacer feet supported on enlarged low side platform. Fit insulated spacers and adapter through verified holes, then two insulating top washers andM2x20 screws with nuts under platform
Finger support during nut tightening, only light controlled clamp load; no load on solder or pads
Support each soldered lead separately on the SAME carrier after actual local path qualification; do not transfer cable forces to adapter
Disconnect power/label local ends, support body and remove two accessible screws before taking adapter to bench
delivery_gates: Actual holes/diameter/thickness and unchanged supplier revision
Both-side no-pad/solder bearing regions at all spacers/insulators
Actual pad mapping and every local connection within50mm with bends/ends
No energizing while any electrical safety gate OPEN
